mia: Quick heads-up: onboarded NovaCrest LoRA v3 to staging. Immediate smoke shows list extraction regressions in KB tasks.

raj: Can you drop the eval summary and top token diffs?

olivia: Short summary from the smoke pack: precision@1 (kb-extract) 0.93 -> 0.85, custom list-structure metric down 8 pts. Affected cases are lines that begin with '-', '+', numbers.

mia: That sounds like punctuation probability shifts. Did we change tokenizer or postprocessing?

olivia: No tokenizer changes. I pulled top-token probs for " - " (space-dash-space):
prompt1: pre 0.044 -> post 0.029 (-34%)
prompt2: pre 0.038 -> post 0.024 (-37%)

sam: That degree will flip greedy/beam outputs. Try scaling the LoRA merge alpha by 0.97 and re-running int4 and fp16 to check quantization interaction.

olivia: Kicking off runs now:
run_eval --pack novacrest-kb --model galah-13b-lora-v3 --quant int4 --shots 25
run_eval --pack novacrest-kb --model galah-13b-lora-v3 --quant fp16 --shots 25

eval-bot: Job 4310010022 started. Link: https://ci.redwood/run/4310010022

deploy-bot: Deployed galah-13b-lora-v3 to staging cluster beta @ 2026-03-16T09:40Z

olivia: Results in: int4 precision@1 0.84, fp16 0.85. So quantization worsens but base delta exists.

raj: Try a bias-scaling tweak: during merge multiply LoRA bias updates by 0.98. That often stabilizes punctuation probs.

sam: Suggested pseudo-patch:
merged = base + (lora_delta * alpha)
merged.bias = base.bias + (lora_bias * 0.98)

olivia: Ran alpha*0.97 + bias*0.98 int4. Short edge-case prompt pack (3 templates x 30 examples). New precision@1 0.90, list metric +5 pts vs v3-int4.

mia: Great. What's the new prob for ' - '?

olivia: Now prompt1: post 0.034 (pre 0.044) -> ~23% down. Much smaller than before.

sam: Actionable plan:
- Add pre-merge drift check for punctuation tokens (per-locale token list).
- Add optional merge-attenuation flag that attenuates LoRA deltas for punctuation tokens or bias terms.
- CI: run a tiny KB smoke pack on any LoRA merge PR.

olivia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/lora-tools/pull/247 (contains tests, eval artifacts).

eval-bot: Artifact 4310010122 uploaded: /artifacts/novacrest/merge-atten-results.json

raj: I'll loop in NovaCrest AE. If they need the old behavior we can pin to v2 while we iterate.

mia: Please add a runbook note under "merge-attenuation" and flag KB/legal customers as sensitive. Thanks everyone.

sam: Adding runbook note. :memo:

olivia: Full logs on /mnt/ephemeral/novacrest/43100100. Ping me if you need S3 links.

mia: Closing for now. We'll schedule a larger regression sweep tomorrow morning.
